findings.description: Annual fallback and missing valuation-basis evidence did not consistently retain a filing publication date, a stable missing-data locator, and an as-of date.

The shared filing selector mechanically preferred the latest 10-Q even when a later-period 10-K had already been filed, causing the current-state registry and primary cash-flow basis to remain anchored to a stale interim period.

required_shared_remediation: Select the current financial filing by the latest reporting period, with filing date and accession used only as deterministic tie-breakers.
When the selected current filing is a 10-K, use annual cash-flow and capex metrics as the primary current-period basis and do not label stale interim metrics as current.
Anchor subsequent-event review after the selected current filing date.
Preserve publication date, as-of date, source hierarchy, and an explicit locator for annual fallback and missing valuation evidence.
Add shared regression tests for an annual filing that is newer than the latest available interim filing.
After the shared fix, preserve an RPM post-fix run and select a completely new issuer for final S17 acceptance.
